{{Quote|Attack pattern Ignimus. For the Emperor!|An Inquisitorium hunter upon spotting his target|<ref name="SWG:Fotp" />}}
'''Inquisitorium hunters''' were non-[[Force Adept|Force user]] [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]] of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitoriu]]s branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Organization==
Inquisitorium hunters were non-[[Force Adept|Force user]] [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]] serving the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisition]],<ref name="SWG:Fotp" /> an organization of [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] tasked with [[Jedi hunter/Legends|hunting down]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|105|Inquisitorius}}</ref>

These soldiers were equipped with black and red [[Padded armor/Legends|padded armor]]s and monocle [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]]; they were armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster weapons]] and [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]]. They used tactics such as [[attack pattern Ignimus]]. Inquisitorium hunters sometimes worked alongside [[Inquisitorium dark trooper]]s.<ref name="SWG:Fotp" />

==History==
A group of Inquisitorium hunters and Inquisitorium dark troopers were deployed on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to hunt and kill the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xos]]. However, Xos was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] briefly before the Inquisitorius forces localized the Dark Jedi in the [[Southern Jedi Ruins]].<ref name="SWG:Fotp" />

==Behind the scenes==
Inquisitorium hunters were [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Fotp" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Inquisitorium hunters were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:Fotp" />
